facts.fact: Sierra Leone's National Civil Registration Authority (NCRA) is issuing biometric national ID cards, introduced early in 2023, each with an 11-digit National Identification Number as a unique identifier, per Biometric Update.
facts.system: national biometric ID card and NIN

systems.system: national biometric ID card and NIN
systems.platform: ICAO-compliant chip card, personalisation by X Infotech

SLE.note: A card required at checkpoints and a NIN required for public exams are stated, with no check against the ID database described.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that the 11-digit NIN on Sierra Leone's ID card is a unique identifier linked to the card holder's personal details in the national population registry.

SLE.note: Nothing on civil registration offices; ID enrolment centres are identity class.
